title: UFC star Colby Covington outlines intention to transition to the WWE 'within the next two years'
text:
Colby Covington has lost its last two fights and turns 37 this month It is one of the biggest characters in the UFC and is watching wrestling By Spencer Morgan
Published: 20:55 GMT, February 13, 2025 | Updated: 20:59 GMT, February 13, 2025
Colby Covington has revealed that he has his eyes on a transfer to WWE in the next two years.
The former Welter Interim Champion has lost his last two fights and has fallen short in fights for the undisputed title three times.
The 36 -year -old, who is one of MMA’s most divisive characters, is in the race of the final chapters and is looking at the world of professional struggle.
He has previously been accompanied to the cage by the wrestling legend Hulk Hogan and believes that he has what is needed to do it in the WWE.
“I would probably say like two years,” Covington said on his YouTube channel in response to a question about when he plans to go to WWE.
‘I really want to start working in my fight in the ring and my ability to please the crowd in next year or two.

‘Maybe I will go to Orlando and go to the WWE training center. But I really want to start perfecting my trade in WWE and wrestling movements, and I hope to make a transition next year or two.
Covington was defeated by Joaquin Buckley in his last fight in December, losing through Doctor Setpage in the third round.
He plans to return to the octagon quickly, once the UFC can find the right opponent.
“I hope to return there in the next three months,” Covington said. ‘I want a 12 -week training camp.
‘When leaving the last fight, I did not get a training camp. I didn’t train at all. I just appeared because I am a company of the company, I love this company more than nothing.
‘So now, I really want to make sure you get a complete training camp, so I am at my best, so that people can see the true colby, and we will overcome anyone in the world when we receive a complete training camp.
‘Every time the UFC can find a good opponent, a great name that makes the company make a business, then we will enter a 12 -week training camp. Train them all.
